description: List clients with balances and contacts, optionally searched by name, email or number. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/clients.

balance.description: Balance comparison "op:value", op one of lt, lte, gt, gte, eq, e.g. "gt:0".

email.description: Only the client with a contact at this email.

filter.description: Free-text search across name, id number, contact names/emails/phones and custom fields.

number.description: Only the client with this client number.

status.description: Comma-separated record state: active, archived, deleted (e.g. "active"). Omit for all.

name: invoiceninja_list_clients
title: List clients
